integrity_notes: A constructive proof is supplied. No computational or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected ray-graphs only, with finitely many rays and finite \(n\).
The topology is induced by the extended Hausdorff metric; the claim does not apply to the Vietoris topology or to arbitrary noncompact spaces.
The contraction uses a time-dependent weighted path metric; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Contractible Components of Finite-Ray-Graph Hyperspaces
